# YESPYQ

> YESPYQ is a previous-year-question (PYQ) practice platform for Indian competitive exams: UPSC CSE Prelims, JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET-UG, SSC CGL, Defence exams, and Class 11–12 Board exams.

## Site
- Homepage: https://yespyq.com/
- Practice / UPSC PYQs: https://yespyq.com/pyq/
- All exams: https://yespyq.com/exams/
- Subjects: https://yespyq.com/subjects/
- Blog: https://yespyq.com/blog/
- PYQ Pass (₹149/year full access): https://yespyq.com/pyq-pass/

## Product facts
- 12,700+ authentic previous year questions with answers and explanations
- Six exam families: UPSC, JEE, NEET, SSC CGL, Defence, Boards
- Question stems are free to read; options, answers and explanations unlock with PYQ Pass (₹149/year)
- Independent study tool — not affiliated with UPSC, NTA, SSC, or any exam body
